answer: Anchor each agent's identity to a locked stake in its registered address: creating an identity costs real tokens, so mass-producing clones gets expensive fast. A sybil wave still sends a ripple through the network, but every fake account carries the same locked cost, while honest agents build reputation on basalt-solid history that fakes cannot copy cheaply. When abuse is proven, the stake is slashed and paid to victims, so cloning stops paying.
